trigger: a new kInventoryActions row whose .plugin is a named constant, whose .action is a runtime expression, or whose plugin/action contains a digit, added without a matching kSoftwareSources row
classification_rationale: the drift gate claims ordered equality with the collector but silently skipped rows its regex could not read, so a source could get no chip with the gate green
summary: collector_sources applied a [a-z_]-only regex to the initializer and dropped unmatched rows; the architect reproduced it with a probe (unchanged six-item list). Fixed in 56dad7d47: row openers counted against parsed pairs, string-literal .plugin only, charset [a-z0-9_], two GateParsers cases that fail against the old parser (falsifier run: 2 failures with the fix disabled).

trigger: a tooltip containing // or /* (for example a URL) in a future kSoftwareKinds/kSoftwareSources row
classification_rationale: the comment stripper in parse_vocab_table is not string-aware; the failure is loud (declared-size mismatch), so only the contract needed stating
summary: Fixed in 56dad7d47 by documenting in the parse_vocab_table docstring that tooltips must not contain // or /*; no code change.

trigger: an operator reads the new Search-and-filters sentence and hovers an Ecosystem chip
classification_rationale: wording only: ecosystem chip tooltips are the bare id, the sentence said each chip's tooltip says what it covers
summary: Reworded in 56dad7d47 to 'each Kind and Found by chip's tooltip says what it covers'.

trigger: selecting the page test by its full name (Catch2 treats the comma as a list separator)
classification_rationale: the test could not be selected by its own title; the title pre-dates the PR but this gate rewrote the case body
summary: Renamed in place in 56dad7d47 to a comma-free title (tags unchanged); the wildcard 'software page*' runs it (28 cases, 549 assertions).

trigger: a bookmarked or hostile ?source= value that is not in kSoftwareSources
classification_rationale: behaviour is correct (cur == c.v is never true) but unpinned by any test
summary: Added test 'software page: an unknown source leaves every Found-by chip unpressed' in 56dad7d47 (chip count, no aria-pressed=true, pill and hidden input still carry the escaped value).

trigger: hover the app Kind chip on a build where SAM.1/SAM.2 have not landed

summary: Rejected with evidence: wording is the approved mock-up text; the PR must not land before the agent PRs that add kind-app runtime and middleware rows (push-gate dependency note).

classification_rationale: a static_assert message must be a string literal; naming the failing row needs a constexpr-string workaround out of proportion to a build-time hint that already names the table and lists the causes
summary: Rejected: infeasible without disproportionate machinery; the message names the table and the four causes.
